notes: A line whose weights re-fit at every date is a different model at every point — not one consistent object you can read a level off. 3.47.0 charted the rolling walk-forward composite by default; this release makes the overlay ALWAYS a snapshot (Paul's rule, stated as such): - pricing:{SYM}:composite.momw now blends the panel under the LATEST RECORDED weight vector, held fixed across the whole series — one consistent model applied through time. First use on a name with no recording computes and records one automatically. - :YYYY-MM-DD holds the vector recorded at (or nearest before) that date —
